items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I worked with him at Lothar's and I worked with him at Benham's

ctx.x: You don't pay much now, then. Well I'm just on a boat now. I worked, two weeks ago I worked at the, at the, at the, at the Princeville Club, with his violin players Thursday and Friday, you know. About two months ago I worked about five weeks up there, five Thursdays and Friday, you know. What violin player is then? Uh, Baker, Tommy Baker. Oh, he's still in town? Well he was in town, he's gone away again now, he's gone on a summer job. Oh yeah? See when he came in town, he got the job at the Princeville Club…
